analysis_skills.name: requirements-review
analysis_skills.evidence: docs/prd.md defines observable CLI, directory selection, YAML, and AI-consumer requirements; unresolved PRD items are recorded as assumptions rather than blocking rules.

analysis_skills.name: architecture-review
analysis_skills.evidence: cmd/ owns Cobra orchestration; internal/scanner, internal/selector, and internal/generator own discovery, selection, and definition I/O respectively. No cross-layer cycle was found in the inspected Go packages.

analysis_skills.name: change-impact-review
analysis_skills.evidence: Inspected cmd entry points, README examples, docs/prd.md, .ai-requirements.yml, CI, Makefile, and package tests. CLI output and YAML shape are the primary consumer contracts; no database, queue, or external service boundary exists.

analysis_skills.name: security-review
analysis_skills.evidence: Reviewed path resolution in cmd/level.go and cmd/generate.go, directory walking in internal/scanner, YAML parsing/writing in internal/generator, and secret scanning policy. No confirmed critical defect; path containment and output-file behavior remain regression-sensitive.

analysis_skills.name: whitebox-risk-based-test
analysis_skills.evidence: Inspected scanner symlink traversal/visited state, generator nearest-parent and exclusion branches, selector terminal/fallback state transitions, and existing package tests. Required regression focus is CLI contract, path boundaries, selection cancellation, and viewport bounds.

analysis_skills.name: api-compatibility-review
analysis_skills.evidence: The Cobra CLI commands and generated .ai-requirements.yml schema are public repository contracts; README, PRD, and command implementations were compared.

analysis_skills.name: test-quality-review
analysis_skills.evidence: TESTING.md and AGENTS.md define testify, AAA, t.Run, deterministic tests, and race testing. Existing tests cover core packages but several pre-existing tests do not yet follow every stated convention.

analysis_skills.name: goreadable
analysis_skills.evidence: goreadable --format text ./... identified function handleKey in internal/selector/selector.go as exceeding default complexity and argument thresholds; candidates are review signals, not automatic failures.

mechanical_checks.when: Go module and golangci-lint is installed
Markdown, YAML, JSON, and other configured files
Go tests; enforce Arrange-Act-Assert marker order
Go mutation testing; review lived and not-covered mutations
Go readability triage; candidates require semantic review and are not automatic failures

must_quality.rule: Requested behavior is satisfied and demonstrated by tests or evidence
Existing supported behavior is not unintentionally broken
Mutation testing is run for Go changes and lived or not-covered mutations receive an explicit review decision
Repository-local guidance, including TESTING.md/AGENTS.md test conventions and CI-required checks, and public contracts are respected
No critical security defect is introduced

performance_quality.rule: Keep responsibilities, names, and tests easy to evolve

critical_defects: Data loss, corruption, or unsafe migration
Required behavior missing or public API broken without approval
assumptions: The baseline targets the current main branch at HEAD 393c3a3; future changes must update it when tooling, contracts, or quality expectations materially change.
The PRD still lists unresolved product choices; this baseline treats the implemented Cobra commands and .ai-requirements.yml format documented in README.md as the current observable contract.
No repository-specific inspection tool is required because the current build, tests, linters, secret scanner, typo scanner, and formatter provide deterministic checks for the established rules.
goaaa, gomut, goreadable, gormalias, and gostructfmt are installed repository quality tools; their versions are managed outside this repository and must remain available to run the baseline.
The initial gomut run completed with exit code 0 but reported 16 lived and 78 not-covered mutations; this is evidence for test review, not a claim of complete mutation protection.
golangci-lint run ./... exited 5 with 'no go files to analyze' in this environment despite a valid Go module; this is an environment/tooling issue and is not recorded as a pass.
dprint check exited 1 because its incremental cache under /home/ubuntu/.cache/dprint is read-only; formatting status is therefore unverified in this environment.
